## Ownership Structure of Harrowgate Aerostructures plc

Harrowgate Aerostructures plc is a public company with a single class of ordinary shares[2]. The founding family trusts are the largest shareholder group with 38.4% of the shares[1], and a pension trustee holds a further 9.2%[1].

### Group Structure

The group consists of the parent company and four wholly owned subsidiaries, including an operating subsidiary in Portugal[3]. In December 2025 the company sold its tooling business for £36 million in cash[5].

### Institutional Ownership

Institutional investors hold about 46% of the free float[4], and the ten largest institutions hold 31%[4]. The board has seven directors, three of them independent[2].

### Credit Considerations

The concentrated family holding gives stable control but limits the influence of minority shareholders[1][2].
